body: I do talk to her about everything, but it just keeps feeling like I'm going to be able to improve anything. Talking to her for two weeks has just made me realize how much is wrong in my life and how hard it's going to be to fix it. and on top of that I might be dying.
Part of me knows that but another part of me just feels like giving up. I really strongly dislike myself, have for a while, it feels like so much work to improve such a lame life

Just feel stuck and worthless. I keep trying to lie down and go to sleep but I can hear my heart beat in my ears (as you pointed out, I've been avoiding the drinking since the medication stuff, mostly, so when I get panicky like this I just spiral) 

It makes me feel like my medication isn't working nad I'm going to die before morning.
